about: The copy review (prime-game-ui#4). Round 2 was answered on 2026-10-05 and applied. open: questions still waiting for the engineer, each with options a-c; an option lists the rows it would write (empty uk and en remove the key), an option without rows keeps the deck and says so in its label. The deck keeps its current wording until an open question is answered on pages/copy/. decided: what was applied, round 2 first. removed: keys taken out of the deck. asked: when round 2 was put to the engineer; the page ignores answers saved before it. Rules: copy/README.md and docs/research/2026-10-05-ukrainian-localization/report.md.
principle: Гравці досвідчені, гра не для дітей: не пояснюємо звичне й очевидне (що меню не ставить на паузу, що щось нове, знайоме керування), без «водіння за руку».
